parameters.query:
-- The client's number, the agency's WhatsApp number id and when the client
-- last wrote. No row unless it's this agency's WhatsApp conversation.
select
  c.id as conversation_id,
  ct.phone,
  ac.whatsapp_phone_number_id as phone_number_id,
  (select max(m.created_at) from messages m where m.conversation_id = c.id and m.role = 'user') as last_inbound_at
from conversations c
left join contacts ct on ct.id = c.contact_id
left join ai_config ac on ac.tenant_id = c.tenant_id
where c.id = $1::uuid and c.tenant_id = $2::uuid and c.channel = 'whatsapp';

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ messaging_product: 'whatsapp', recipient_type: 'individual', to: $json.to, type: 'text', text: { preview_url: true, body: $json.text } }) }}

nodes.name: Send via WhatsApp API
nodes.notes: The same "WhatsApp Cloud API token" credential as workflows 25 and 27.
